_comment: intake island TESTS toolchain (the spec root's tests, islands/intake/specs/): python 3.15 + uv (the launch island's shape, same nixpkgs flake ref) and yq (package yq-go) for the YAML records. Kept apart from islands/intake/devbox.json on purpose: that file is what every live sitting's bootstrap installs, and the tests must not grow it. Run `bash ../scripts/ci.sh` (it enters this devbox); the repo-root diff-ci row `-- bash islands/intake/scripts/ci.sh` reaches it. The repo-root devbox.json/devbox.lock are never touched.
